Privacy Policy

Live Moment: Weather Wallpaper · Last updated: 30 September 2026

The short version

  • Live Moment turns a photo you choose into AI-animated wallpapers. To do this, your photo is sent to our servers and then to third-party AI providers: Pixazo and the AI model developers it works with. Any faces in the photo go with it, including family members and children.
  • Our servers are in the United States, and the AI providers may process your photo in the United States, India and other countries. That can be outside your country.
  • Only upload photos of people who agreed. Only upload photos of a child if you are that child's parent or legal guardian.
  • Temporary copies are deleted automatically, usually within a day or two. Your creations stay in your private library until you delete them or delete your account.
  • You can delete your account in the app. We cannot make AI providers delete copies they hold. See Deleting your data.
  • We do not sell personal data, and the app shows no ads.

1. Who we are

Live Moment: Weather Wallpaper ("Live Moment", "the app") is an Android app offered by Yunus Emre Sarı, Sancaktepe/İstanbul, Türkiye ("we", "us"). We are the controller of the personal data described here, which means we decide how and why it is used.

Contact for anything in this policy: 1yesari1@gmail.com

4. AI processing and who receives your data

This is the most important part of this policy. Creating a wallpaper works like this:

  1. You choose a photo. It is uploaded over an encrypted connection to private cloud storage.
  2. To make the starting image, our server sends your photo to an AI image provider. It is sent as a file or through a temporary link that stops working after a short time.
  3. After you approve the starting image, our server sends that image to an AI video provider, which animates it. The starting image is made from your photo, so it shows the same faces.
  4. The results come back to our server. We keep them temporarily and copy them into your private library, so you can restore them after reinstalling.
  5. The temporary upload of your original photo is deleted as soon as processing has finished.

Faces, including those of family members and children, are processed by these providers. The table shows who they are.

RecipientWhat forWhat it receivesWhere
Google Cloud and Firebase (Google)Our servers, sign-in, database, file storage, app checksAccount data, photos, results, technical dataUnited States (our storage is in Iowa). Google operates worldwide.
Pixazo (operated by Appy Pie LLP), our AI processor, and the AI model developers it routes to (we reach them only through Pixazo), such as Black Forest Labs (FLUX), ByteDance (Seedream, Seedance), Google (Nano Banana, Gemini Omni), OpenAI (GPT Image), MiniMax (Hailuo), Alibaba (Qwen, Wan), Kuaishou (Kling), Lightricks (LTX), Vidu and HiDreamAI image and video generation (every request goes here)Your photo or the starting image, plus our fixed style instructionsIndia, the United States and other countries where the model developers operate

The AI providers change from time to time, and the model developers behind a provider can change without notice. We keep this list current, and on request we will tell you which providers we use.

What providers do with your data

  • They process your photo on our behalf to produce the result, under the terms we accepted with Pixazo. Pixazo passes your photo to the model developer that runs the model. Each also has its own terms and privacy policy.
  • They may scan photos and results for prohibited content, and may refuse a photo. Some keep generated files or technical records for a limited period, for example to detect abuse. Those periods are set by them, not by us.
  • Provider terms differ. Some say they do not use photos sent through their business API to train their models, but that promise can be limited, for example to inputs only or with exceptions, and some providers reserve the right to use technical or usage data to improve their services. We cannot guarantee it for every provider and model, and provider terms can change.
  • We cannot make providers delete their copies. Deleting your account removes what we hold. Copies held by AI providers are deleted under their own retention rules.

5. International transfers

Your data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the United States (Iowa). AI providers, and the model developers behind them, may process it in the United States, India and other countries. Some of those countries may not give your data the same protection as your own country.

Where the law requires a transfer mechanism (for example from the EEA, the UK or Türkiye), we rely on an adequacy decision where one exists, on standard contractual clauses or other safeguards recognised by that law, or, for individual transfers where the law allows it, on your explicit consent, which you give when you confirm the upload notice and create a wallpaper. Ask us if you would like a summary of the safeguards.

6. Photos of other people and children

  • Only upload a photo if you have the permission of everyone who can be recognised in it.
  • Only upload a photo of a child if you are that child's parent or legal guardian. Do not upload other people's children.
  • If you are in a photo that someone else uploaded and you want it removed, write to us. We will delete what we hold. We cannot force providers to delete their copies.

The app asks you to confirm these things before your first upload, and the Terms of Use say that uploading a photo confirms them.

8. Deleting your data

  • Delete your account in the app: Profile → Account → Delete account. This erases your account, sign-in methods, plan records, feedback, reports, and every image and video we hold for you, including the library and free preview copies. It also clears the data on your phone.
  • Delete a creation: deleting it in your Library also removes its cloud copy.
  • If you no longer have the app: use the account deletion page.

Deleting your account does not cancel a Google Play subscription. Cancel it in Google Play so you are not charged again. It also does not delete files you saved to your Gallery or Downloads or shared with others, and it does not delete copies held by AI providers or the purchase records described above.

9. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

  • get a copy of your personal data and information about how we use it;
  • correct data that is wrong or incomplete;
  • have your data erased;
  • restrict or object to some uses;
  • receive your data in a portable format;
  • withdraw consent at any time, without affecting what was done before;
  • complain to your data protection authority. In the EU or EEA this is your national authority, in the UK the Information Commissioner's Office, and in Türkiye the Personal Data Protection Board (KVKK).

To use these rights, write to 1yesari1@gmail.com from the email address of your account. We may ask you to confirm it is you. We reply within one month (30 days in Türkiye).

United States. We do not sell personal information and we do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising. Residents of states with privacy laws can ask us to tell them what we hold, correct it or delete it, using the same address, and will not be treated worse for doing so.

10. Security

Data travels over encrypted connections. Your photos and results sit in private storage, and links to them are short-lived and only given to you or to the provider doing the work. Requests to our servers need a signed-in account, and we use Google's app-integrity checks (Firebase App Check with Play Integrity) to help detect requests that do not come from the real app. This website sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts or fonts, with one exception: the Delete data and Delete account pages load Google's Firebase sign-in scripts (from gstatic.com and apis.google.com) when you open them, so that you can sign in with Google to delete your wallpapers or your account there. Those pages then talk to Google sign-in and to our servers. Your sign-in session stays in your browser's storage until you sign out. The website is hosted on GitHub Pages, so GitHub can see your IP address when you open a page. No system is perfectly secure, so please keep your account safe.

11. AI-generated content and reporting

Everything Live Moment creates from your photo is generated by AI. It can be inaccurate, can look different from the real person or scene, and is not a real recording. Do not present it as one, and say that it was made with AI where the law or a platform requires it. Some AI providers already add invisible markers to results (for example Google's SynthID). Do not remove or hide any label or marker. We may add visible labels or hidden markers ourselves in the future, or where the law requires.

Our style templates are fixed, so you cannot type free-text prompts. They tell the AI to keep results family-friendly, and the providers add their own safety filters. These safeguards are not perfect.

If a result is sexual, violent, dangerous, shows the wrong person or is otherwise inappropriate, use the Report button in the app, or write to 1yesari1@gmail.com with the subject "Report". We look at the result you reported, which may include opening it in your library, and use reports to improve our filters. Read the Acceptable Use Policy for what is not allowed.

12. Children

Live Moment is not for anyone under 18 and is not directed at children. If you think a child has made an account, write to us and we will delete it. Photos of children may be uploaded only by their parent or legal guardian, as described in section 6.

13. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will update the date above and tell you in the app or by email before the change takes effect where the law requires it.
